system_binaries.name: pandoc
system_binaries.reason: Required for `pdf` and `docx` compile targets. Markdown / LaTeX / USPTO XML work without it.

system_binaries.name: pdflatex
system_binaries.reason: Required for high-quality PDF output (pandoc falls back to a lower-fidelity engine without it).

env_vars.name: MISTRAL_API_KEY
env_vars.reason: Only needed when RESEARCH_PDF_PROVIDER=mistral for figure-aware PDF ingest. Local pdf-parse-lite fallback needs nothing.

readme_sections.title: Prerequisites
readme_sections.body:
- Node.js (implicit from the CLI runtime).
- Optional: `pandoc` + `pdflatex` for PDF export (LaTeX target works without).
- Optional API keys for real providers:
  - `MISTRAL_API_KEY` — layout-aware PDF extraction (`RESEARCH_PDF_PROVIDER=mistral`).
  - `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or `OPENAI_API_KEY` — vision-capable gateway for figure descriptions / claim verification (the Vision Analyst agent picks the model via its own gateway config, not through a tool).
